card.name: Small words in genetics and science texts
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, the, into, whose, single and specific. They fall right before a science noun in explanatory text on genes, DNA, cells or lab studies.

modes.label: Prepositions before study setting
modes.description: A word like in or into just before animals, mice or test-tube experiments.
modes.example: Based on studies<< in>> animals, the ROR2 protein appears

modes.description: The word the or a short modifier right before DNA or gene structure words.

modes.label: Modifiers in physics or biology
modes.description: Words like single, different or specific placed before a technical noun.
modes.example: it acts like a single atom that can occupy two<< different>> energy states.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted and suppressed tokens; it perhaps nudges toward a plain science noun and away from prefix-like word starts.
